regulations.description: IP Code standard for ingress protection
Sterilization of health-care products - Moist heat

tests.requirement: No warning or safety notice provided regarding the maximum fill level; no HAZARDOUS SITUATION or unacceptable RISK due to overflow when reservoir filled to 15% above maximum capacity and TRANSPORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT tilted 10°, or MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT >45kg moved over threshold per 9.4.2.4.3

tests.name: Spillage on ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS handling liquids in NORMAL USE; liquid poured steadily on top based on RISK ANALYSIS
tests.result_remark: Not handling liquids in NORMAL USE

tests.name: Dielectric strength and leakage current after spillage
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT met dielectric strength and LEAKAGE CURRENT tests; un-insulated electrical parts not wet
tests.result_remark: Not handling liquids in NORMAL USE

tests.name: Ingress of water or particulate matter into ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT with IP Code placed in least favourable position of NORMAL USE and subjected to tests of IEC 60529

tests.name: Dielectric strength and leakage current after ingress test
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT met dielectric strength and LEAKAGE CURRENT tests; no bridging of insulation or electrical components resulting in loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE

tests.name: Cleaning and disinfection - single cycle
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT/ME SYSTEM and their parts and ACCESSORIES cleaned or disinfected once using methods specified in instructions for use including any cooling or drying period

tests.name: Dielectric strength and leakage current after cleaning
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT met dielectric strength and LEAKAGE CURRENT tests; no deterioration resulting in unacceptable RISK

tests.name: Effects of multiple cleanings/disinfections
tests.requirement: Effects of multiple cleanings/disinfections during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE evaluated by MANUFACTURER; processes did not cause loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE

tests.name: Sterilization of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS
Sterilization assessment per ISO 11135-1, ISO 11137-1, or ISO 17665-1
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT, ME SYSTEMS and their parts or ACCESSORIES intended to be sterilized assessed and documented

tests.name: Dielectric strength and leakage current after sterilization
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT complied with dielectric strength and LEAKAGE CURRENT tests; no deterioration resulting in unacceptable RISK

tests.name: Compatibility risks with sterilization substances
tests.requirement: RISKs associated with compatibility of substances used with ME EQUIPMENT addressed in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS as confirmed by examination of RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.name: Biological compatibility assessment
tests.requirement: ME EQUIPMENT, ME SYSTEM, and ACCESSORIES coming into direct or indirect contact with biological tissues, cells, or body fluids assessed and documented per ISO 10993

tests.name: Interruption and restoration of power supply
tests.requirement: Interruption and restoration of power supply did not result in a loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE

tests.name: ACCURACY OF CONTROLS AND INSTRUMENTS AND PROTECTION AGAINST HAZARDOUS OUTPUTS
Accuracy of controls and instruments - risk management
tests.requirement: RISKs associated with accuracy of controls and instruments stated in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS confirmed by RISK MANAGEMENT FILE review

tests.name: Risk of poor usability
tests.requirement: Risk of poor usability, including identification, marking, and documents addressed in a USABILITY ENGINEERING process

identifiers.context: Ingress protection rating per IEC 60529, clause 11.6.5

semantic_fragments.content: ME EQUIPMENT with IP Code placed in least favourable position of NORMAL USE and subjected to tests of IEC 60529 (IP Code). Result: IP 22. ME EQUIPMENT met dielectric strength and LEAKAGE CURRENT tests and there were no bridging of insulation or electrical components that could result in the loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE in NORMAL CONDITION or in combination with a SINGLE FAULT CONDITION.

Effects of multiple cleanings/disinfections during EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE of EQUIPMENT evaluated by MANUFACTURER and assurance that the processes did not cause a loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE. See RM Results Table 11.6.6.
ME EQUIPMENT, ME SYSTEM, and ACCESSORIES coming into direct or indirect contact with biological tissues, cells, or body fluids assessed and documented per ISO 10993. Verdict: N/E (Not Evaluated).
Risk of poor usability, including identification, marking, and documents addressed in a USABILITY ENGINEERING process. Result: Refer to usability test report. Verdict: P.
